Definition: apparently a primary verb; to liquefy:--melt.
BiblicalUsage: The word is to melt, to liquefy with heat. Peter says the day of God is coming wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat. In the Greek the word stands in the middle voice, being melted, as the elements are undone by the fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the melting of the elements is the end of this world and the beginning of the new one Peter promises.
